verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party rules or automation engine where a user defines event-triggered actions. The per-request callback URL is a result-delivery mechanism, not a rule. Voice-agent function calling is a developer building block. CLI exit codes for scripts are a user-side scripting workaround. None of these counts as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
